verdict: Yes, for a founder who knows cricket coaching. Freebowler pitched a non-electric, portable bowling machine on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Electric bowling machines are expensive and need power, so a cheaper portable option opens up academies, schools and serious amateurs in small towns.
angle: India has thousands of cricket academies and millions of serious amateur players, but most can't afford imported bowling machines. A portable machine sells to academies, schools, clubs and parents of young players. Coaches are the key influencers, and service and spare parts must be easy to get.
